title: Monada Villa is for sale
hook_A: Every home has a story.
hook_B: Our home is ready for its next story.
caption:
Every home has a story. Ours is ready for a new chapter.

Over the past month we've shared the little things that make Monada special — the light, the tropical garden, the quiet spaces.

Today we're sharing something new: Monada Villa is for sale.

In Pererenan, Bali: 600 m² of land with a large tropical garden, a ≈230 m² house, two ensuite bedrooms, a separate home office plus a large workspace in the master bedroom, an 8 × 3 m pool and on-site parking.
Footage in this campaign comes from our 2023–2024 home archive — ask us about the property's present condition.
